scope: Four fresh real-model q8192/out512 processes run OFF,ON,ON,OFF with the same new CK DLL. Other whole/MoE/FLA/CLI/AOT artifacts, tables, prompt and GB10 oracle are fixed. The sole environment difference is the register-rescale option. Both the native producer and complete compacted canonical replay use an explicit FP32 register multiply at the original K32 alpha boundary; original error bounds, reciprocal function, candidate collector and every K16 exact group remain. All512 raw output IDs, actual callbacks and first-logit tolerance0.125 attach to each run. Activation markers identify all10 eligible prefill calls and no decode use. Two observations per mode provide a limited repeated comparison, without long-term thermal/stability claims. No prefix, long-context, packaged HTTP or release qualification is inherited.

decision.decision: Retain the register-rescale option as enabled in the next experimental q8192 control. Four fresh real-model processes pass every original GB10 token, first logit and actual callback. Both ON observations are below both OFF observations, with a537.79505ms median TTFT saving. This remains a limited two-observation-per-mode comparison. Keep code and package defaults off; real TTFT27328.8799ms remains above10000ms and the immutable retained4187.415605ms target. Continue a broader replacement of the remaining canonical arithmetic and correction costs. No prefix, long-context, packaged HTTP, retained-performance or release acceptance is granted.
